Answer: F
Reason: The CT images demonstrate extensive subcutaneous emphysema and bilateral pneumothoraces without evidence of rib fractures (ruling out trauma) or medical devices (ruling out iatrogenic causes). This pattern is characteristic of air tracking from a spontaneous pneumomediastinum into the pleural spaces and subcutaneous tissues, often due to alveolar rupture (Macklin effect).
